newsitem.title: UK: UK B/socs net new approvals s/a 3.72 bln in Sept.
newsitem.headline: UK B/socs net new approvals s/a 3.72 bln in Sept.

text.p: The UK Building Societies Association (BSA) released the following, seasonally adjusted, data on lending -
MORTGAGE ADVANCES AND NEW APPROVALS TO LEND (in 1000s)
NOTES - approval = borrower accepts offer of advance; advance = actual loan, on average some 10 wks after commitment; advances tend to reflect new approvals made 2 or 3 mths ago.

Adrian Coles, director-general of the BSA said: "Building society net and gross mortgage lending fell slightly on the previous month on both a seasonally adjusted and unadjusted basis. However, compared with last year the strength of the recovery is clear."
Coles said gross advances in September were nearly 30 percent higher than last year and net advances were 80 percent higher, reflecting the increase in new lending as opposed to remortgaging.
Net advances in the third quarter were the highest for four years and gross advances at their highest level for five years.
